agents.name: cursor
agents.description: Cursor CLI agent over ACP (stdio JSON-RPC).
agents.authHint: Run `agent login` in your terminal (or set CURSOR_API_KEY) before connecting.
agents.installHint: Install the Cursor CLI (no GUI needed): `curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS | bash`, then ensure `agent` is on your PATH.

agents.name: codex-cli
agents.description: OpenAI Codex via the official ACP adapter.
agents.authHint: Run `codex` once and choose Sign in with ChatGPT (or set CODEX_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY).
agents.installHint: Install the Codex CLI (no GUI needed): `curl -fsSL https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.sh | sh`, then run `codex` once to sign in. Pipper connects over ACP automatically.

agents.name: claude-code
agents.description: Claude Agent SDK via the official ACP adapter.
agents.authHint: Run `claude` once and complete the login prompt (or set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).
agents.installHint: Install the Claude CLI (no GUI needed): `curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash` (native install auto-updates). Pipper connects over ACP automatically.

agents.name: gemini-cli
agents.description: Gemini CLI in ACP mode (stdio JSON-RPC).
agents.authHint: Sign in with your Google account on first run (or set GEMINI_API_KEY).
agents.installHint: npm install -g @google/gemini-cli  (or use npx on first launch)

agents.name: copilot-cli
agents.description: GitHub Copilot CLI as an ACP server (stdio JSON-RPC).
agents.authHint: Run `copilot` once to sign in with GitHub before connecting.
agents.installHint: npm install -g @github/copilot  (or use npx on first launch)

agents.name: opencode
agents.description: opencode CLI in ACP mode (stdio JSON-RPC).
agents.authHint: Run `opencode auth login` to configure a provider before connecting.
agents.installHint: npm install -g opencode-ai  (or use npx on first launch)

agents.name: grok
agents.description: Grok Build CLI in ACP mode (stdio JSON-RPC).
agents.authHint: Run `grok login` to sign in via browser (or `grok login --device-auth` on headless machines).
agents.installHint: Install the Grok CLI (no GUI needed): `curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh | bash`, then verify with `grok --version`.

agents.name: antigravity
agents.description: Google's official ACP agent, installed into Pipper's cache on first use.
agents.authHint: Sign in to Google Antigravity to continue.
agents.installHint: Pipper downloads Google's official ACP server on first use.

agents.name: devin
agents.description: Devin CLI in ACP mode (stdio JSON-RPC).
agents.authHint: Run `/login` inside a `devin` session to authenticate before connecting.
agents.installHint: Install the Devin CLI, then ensure `devin` is on your PATH.

agents.name: pipper-mock
agents.description: Local mock ACP agent for development and tests.
